description: See what's in one layer — including `lapsed`, to answer 'what did I let go of'. Paginated: default limit 50, raise it only if you actually need more in one call (a large unpaginated layer can be megabytes of JSON, which will crowd out everything else in your context). `sourceGone: true` on an item means it's no longer found in any browser source that was successfully scanned (the record itself is never deleted). This call may first persist lazy expiry/drip housekeeping (see README) even if you only meant to read.
name: list_layer
title: List one layer (paginated)
